d9c4214f439ec4d6.description: Position Overview Are you an experienced finance leader looking for a broad country eadership role within a complex multinational environment Our client is seeking a Finance Director to take ownership of its finance and administrative functions across Saudi Arabia. Leading a team of approximately 10, this is a highly visible role which requires a direct and hands on focus across financial reporting, treasury, tax and legal entity governance. Working closely with senior country and regional leadership, you will play a critical role in safeguarding strong financial controls while acting as a strategic partner to the wider business Benefits to the Applicant This is an opportunity to step into a broad leadership position that goes well beyond traditional finance management. You will have the opportunity to influence key commercial and financial decisions, drive process simplification and operational efficiency, and navigate a sophisticated regulatory and tax environment. The role offers significant exposure across business partnering, treasury, tax, IFRS reporting, transfer pricing and legal entity financial management. With regular interaction across senior country and regional stakeholders, as well as external auditors, financial institutions, tax advisors and government authorities, this position provides the successful candidate with genuine influence over the financial direction and effectiveness of the Saudi operation. Requirements Given the breadth and seniority of the position, our client is looking for candidates who can demonstrate: Master’s degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting or a related discipline. Minimum 10 years in senior roles with progressively increasing responsibility Strong experience operating within a complex FMCG globally operating multinational organisation In-depth knowledge across accounting, IFRS, taxation, treasury and legal entity financial management. Strong understanding of the Saudi economic, regulatory and business environment, combined with excellent senior stakeholder management and communication skills.

d9eb6059bdb95119.description: Job description About the job Diamond Drillers Job Title: Diamond Driller Department: APC Mining Section: Exploration – Mining & Geotechnical Drilling Reporting To: Operations Supervisor Job Purpose: Responsible for the safe operation and maintenance of diamond core drilling rigs, achieving high core recovery, maintaining accurate drilling records, and guiding work crews at the site. Key Responsibilities: Operate and maintain diamond core drilling rigs safely and efficiently. Ensure high-quality core recovery and accurate sampling. Apply knowledge of drilling fluids, downhole tools, and core handling techniques. Operate drilling equipment according to project specifications and achieve target depths and core recovery. Control drilling angles and azimuth (AZ) according to geological requirements. Manage drilling fluids under varying soil and rock conditions. Monitor drilling progress, penetration rates, and ground conditions. Handle core barrels and retrieve core samples with maximum recovery. Label, store, and protect core samples to maintain their quality and integrity. Record drilling depth, core recovery percentages, and lithological observations accurately. Identify and resolve common drilling issues, including stuck rods, water loss, loose ground, and unstable formations. Maintain daily drilling logs, core recovery records, shift reports, and technical documentation. Communicate drilling progress and operational issues to supervisors and geologists. Follow company policies, standard operating procedures, and site-specific HSE requirements. Ensure proper use of personal protective equipment (PPE) and compliance with safety standards. Participate in incident investigations and follow emergency procedures when required. Support continuous improvement, cost reduction, and productivity initiatives. Work effectively with field engineers, supervisors, and drilling offsiders. Qualifications and Experience: High school diploma or equivalent. 5–7 years of proven experience in diamond core drilling operations. Strong knowledge of drilling fluids, downhole tools, and sampling techniques. Ability to work in remote locations under rotation schedules. Basic English reading and writing skills for following instructions and completing technical reports. Strong commitment to safety, accuracy, and professionalism. Required Skills: Strong teamwork and communication skills. Problem-solving abilities. Physical fitness to handle demanding field conditions. Ability to adapt to remote locations, rotation schedules, and extended working hours. Positive work attitude and accountability. Working Conditions: High-exposure working environment. High level of physical or mental injury risk. Must comply with site safety regulations and client defensive driving requirements, including relevant training. Reporting Relationship: Operations Supervisor Supervisory Responsibility: None Note: This job description is not exhaustive. Additional job-related duties may be assigned as required. Apply now! Preferred candidate Years of experience No experience required Degree Bachelor's degree / higher diploma

d90f871385019872.description: About the Role Swatch Group is seeking a Retail Operations Manager to oversee and coordinate all retail operational activities across its boutiques in Jeddah and Makkah, Makkah region. This full-time role ensures business continuity, operational readiness, and compliance with operational standards, acting as the operational owner of boutique infrastructure and support services. Key Responsibilities Oversee daily operational readiness, ensuring boutiques are fully operational before opening and properly secured after closing. Conduct regular operational inspections and monitor compliance with operational standards and company procedures. Manage boutique opening and closing procedures, including secure control of master keys and coordination of emergency access. Coordinate preventive and corrective maintenance activities, following up on requests and ensuring all boutique facilities remain operational and compliant. Support Brand Managers in resolving escalated customer issues and coordinate operational actions to address customer concerns promptly. Act as the primary operational liaison between Retail Operations and support departments, coordinating with Logistics, Warehouse, IT, Finance, Government Relations, HR, and external service providers. Conduct operational compliance audits, monitor the implementation of company procedures, and identify process improvement opportunities. Prepare weekly and monthly operational reports, monitor KPIs, track maintenance trends, and support retail expansion projects. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5-10 years of relevant experience in retail operations management. Demonstrated ability to oversee and coordinate operational activities across multiple retail locations. Experience in facility management, maintenance coordination, and customer issue resolution. Strong understanding of operational standards, compliance, and security procedures. Key Performance Indicators Performance will be measured against key indicators including Boutique Operational Readiness, Boutique Opening and Closing Compliance, Operational Audit Score, Maintenance Response Time, Customer Complaint Resolution Time, and Operational Compliance Score. Working Relationships The Retail Operations Manager will work closely with internal stakeholders such as the Country Manager, Brand Managers, Warehouse & Logistics, Finance, HR, and IT. External relationships include landlords, maintenance contractors, security providers, mall management, and other service providers. Challenges of the Role Key challenges include maintaining operational consistency across multiple boutique locations, coordinating activities without disrupting commercial performance, ensuring rapid response to incidents, supporting business growth while maintaining excellence, and protecting boutique infrastructure to ensure business continuity.

d9414ec3af8de621.description: About Binzagr CORO Binzagr CORO is a joint venture between the Binzagr Company and Denmark-based CO-RO, providing refreshment through brands such as Suntop, Suncola, and Sunquick. The company combines strong roots in Saudi Arabia with international reach and expertise in the beverage business. The Role of Personal Assistant to CEO Binzagr CORO is seeking a Personal Assistant to the Chief Executive Officer to join the team in Makkah, with operations also in Jeddah. This full-time role is suitable for candidates with 0-1 years of experience, including fresh graduates, and involves providing comprehensive administrative and coordination support to the CEO. Key Responsibilities Manage the CEO’s calendar, appointments, meetings, and daily priorities. Coordinate internal and external meetings, including agendas, materials, and follow-ups. Prepare meeting agendas, briefing materials, minutes, and action logs. Draft professional correspondence and manage communications with executives, guests, and stakeholders. Arrange domestic and international travel, including flights, hotels, transportation, visas, and itineraries. Coordinate executive meetings, corporate events, dinners, and special engagements. Manage invitations, venues, suppliers, hospitality, and event logistics. Maintain organized digital and physical records and handle confidential information with discretion. Utilize Microsoft 365, collaboration platforms, digital filing systems, and approved AI tools to enhance productivity and efficiency. Track decisions, deadlines, commitments, and action items to ensure timely follow-up. Coordinate logistics and visit planning for the CEO and key guests. Minimum Requirements Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related field. 0–2 years of relevant experience; fresh graduates may be considered. d969da98502e648f.description: About Masterworks and Nabeh Masterworks is an IT services company. Nabeh, a subsidiary of Masterworks, specializes in AI-powered solutions designed to automate operations, enhance efficiency, and drive innovation. Their expertise spans computer vision, large language model (LLM) applications, speech-to-text technology, data intelligence, and low-code AI solutions. The Role of Sales Coordinator Nabeh is seeking a full-time Sales Coordinator to support its sales operations in Riyadh, Riyadh Province. This role involves coordinating tender and RFP submissions, managing sales communications, maintaining company documentation, processing orders through NetSuite, and following up on finance and payment requirements. The Sales Coordinator will ensure accurate documentation, timely submissions, and effective coordination across internal teams and external stakeholders. Key Responsibilities Coordinate tender and RFP submissions via Etimad and SAP Ariba portals, ensuring timely and accurate submission of required documents. Monitor tender deadlines, clarifications, portal updates, and submission statuses, and maintain organized tender records. Manage the sales email inbox, acknowledge inquiries, direct requests to relevant stakeholders, and follow up on pending responses. Maintain company certificates, registrations, and supporting documents, and coordinate renewals before expiry. Create and update approved purchase orders and sales orders in NetSuite, ensuring accuracy and completeness. Coordinate with Operations and PMO to follow up on order progress, delivery requirements, supporting documents, and outstanding actions. Follow up with Finance on payment requirements, invoices, approvals, and supporting documentation. Coordinate vendor and supplier registration activities, collect required documents, and follow up on registration status. Maintain a consolidated tracker of tender submissions, orders, certificate renewals, registrations, and pending payment requirements. Prepare regular status updates and reports, highlighting upcoming deadlines, delays, and outstanding actions requiring management attention. Coordinate with internal teams and external stakeholders to ensure smooth sales operations and timely completion of assigned tasks. Experience with Etimad, SAP Ariba, and NetSuite is preferred. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel and Outlook. Required Skills Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple deadlines. Strong communication, coordination, and follow-up skills. Ability to handle confidential business information and documentation professionally.

d9e1fc83e36e2c18.description: About Majd Yanbu Industrial Company Majd Yanbu Industrial Company is a Saudi limited liability company established as a 50/50 joint venture between Elsewedy Cables Company and Alfanar Electrical Systems. The company operates a manufacturing facility in Yanbu Industrial City, under the Royal Commission for Jubail and Yanbu. This facility specializes in producing high-purity copper rods for electrical and industrial applications, serving customers across Saudi Arabia and the GCC region. About the Role Majd Yanbu Industrial Company is seeking a Quality Control Lab Technician to join their team in Yanbu Al Sinaiyah, Al Madinah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves ensuring the quality of copper rods, raw materials, and related products through various testing and inspection procedures. The ideal candidate will have 2-5 years of experience in a manufacturing quality control environment. Key Responsibilities Perform quality inspection, sampling, and testing of copper rods, raw materials, and related products. Conduct physical, chemical, electrical, and metallurgical tests, including conductivity, tensile strength, elongation, and resistivity. Ensure compliance with ASTM B49, ASTM B117, BS EN 1977, BS EN 1978, customer specifications, and internal quality standards. Monitor production quality, process parameters, and product traceability. Verify laboratory equipment calibration and ensure reliable test results. Identify and control non-conforming products, reduce defects and scrap, and support continuous improvement initiatives. Coordinate with cross-functional teams to resolve quality issues and prepare daily quality reports. Qualifications and Experience Diploma in a relevant technical field. 2–3 years of experience in quality control within a manufacturing environment. Experience in copper rod, wire, cable, metal processing, or continuous casting is preferred. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with attention to detail. Work Location This position is based in Yanbu Al Sinaiyah, Al Madinah, Saudi Arabia, serving customers across the Kingdom and the wider GCC region. Application Process Qualified candidates are invited to apply for this full-time position. Salary details will be disclosed during the interview process.

This includes transforming raw content into easily understandable visual formats, ensuring all designs align with brand guidelines, and leveraging digital design tools to enhance communication effectiveness. Ensure all visual designs maintain consistency with internal brand guidelines. Customize visuals to effectively reflect the target audience and communication objectives. Transform complex content into clear and engaging visual formats. Utilize storytelling techniques to develop compelling visual narratives. Manage and maintain a library of editable design assets and templates. Ensure that all team members have access to up-to-date design files. Apply proficiency in digital design tools such as Canva, Adobe Suite, and video editing applications. Propose innovative visual ideas to enhance the presentation of routine content. d90cc4904b5cafb2.description: نبذة عن مهندس الإنتاج تبحث شركة الزامل للهياكل الإنشائية والفولاذية عن مهندس إنتاج للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تخطيط وتنسيق أنشطة وإجراءات الإنتاج في الموقع الصناعي، بالإضافة إلى تطوير تقنيات الإنتاج والمنتجات. الهدف من الوظيفة يهدف مهندس الإنتاج إلى ضمان سير عمليات الإنتاج بكفاءة وفعالية، من خلال إعداد برامج الإنتاج وتطوير التقنيات المستخدمة، مع التركيز على تحسين الجودة وزيادة المخرجات. كما يتولى إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بنتائج الأعمال. المسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد خطط وبرامج الإنتاج وتنظيم تسلسل عمليات التشغيل والإنتاج. تحديد كمية ونوعية الإنتاج وضمان جودة العمليات ومطابقة مواصفات المنتج. متابعة وتطوير تقنيات الإنتاج من خلال إدخال طرق وخطوط إنتاج ومعدات جديدة لتحسين الكفاءة الإنتاجية وزيادة المخرجات. دراسة معوقات الإنتاج وإيجاد الحلول المناسبة لها. إعداد برامج الصيانة الوقائية لآلات ومعدات المصنع وفقاً لتعليمات الشركة المصنعة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشاريع الهندسية ونسب تقدمها، وعرضها وتوضيحها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تخطيط وتنسيق أنشطة الإنتاج. مهارات جيدة في إعداد التقارير والوثائق الفنية. بيئة العمل يعمل مهندس الإنتاج ضمن فريق في بيئة صناعية بالدمام، المنطقة الشرقية، ويكون مسؤولاً عن دعم عمليات الإنتاج لشركة الزامل للهياكل الإنشائية والفولاذية. معلومات إضافية هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل، والراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة.

d9193ffe15bf7c79.description: About the Role Catrion Group is seeking a Culinary Instructor to join their team in Jeddah. Maintain training summary reports and program assessments. Provide support in the planning and delivery of Graduation Ceremonies, Academy Events, and activities. Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English (mandatory) and Arabic (preferred). d91f167dc136e6bd.description: About the Role Marriott International is seeking a Chef de Partie to join its Food and Beverage and Culinary department in Riyadh. This is a full-time, non-management position focused on food preparation and cooking within a dynamic kitchen environment. The role requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities in the Kitchen Prepare and cook food items, including special meals, substitutions, and cold foods, adhering to quality, presentation, and checklist standards. Operate and regulate kitchen equipment such as ovens, broilers, grills, and roasters. Ensure proper thawing of frozen food products. Portion, arrange, and garnish food items before serving. Maintain accurate food logs and monitor the quality and quantity of prepared dishes. Communicate excess food to the Chef and inform service staff about daily specials or unavailable menu items. Provide clear communication regarding support needs during peak service periods. Team Collaboration and Safety Support management in various tasks including hiring, training, scheduling, evaluating, counseling, and coaching employees. Adhere strictly to all established safety and security policies and procedures. Report any maintenance requirements or unsafe conditions promptly. Complete all mandatory safety training as required. Address guest needs and inquiries professionally and efficiently. Maintain professional communication with colleagues and guests. Contribute actively to achieving team goals and objectives. The role involves physical demands including extended periods of standing, sitting, or walking. Ability to handle and lift objects weighing up to 25 pounds without assistance. The role operates within a professional kitchen setting, requiring consistent adherence to operational standards and collaborative teamwork.

d931517bdd92a5d2.description: About the Role NMDC Energy is seeking a Senior Offshore Construction Engineer for full-time projects located in Eastern, Saudi Arabia. This role is responsible for coordinating and monitoring activities across various project execution phases, assisting, and leading Construction Engineers in assigned tasks. The Senior Offshore Construction Engineer will report to the Offshore Construction Manager / Sr. Offshore Construction Manager and may work on multiple projects simultaneously. Key Responsibilities Across Project Phases Assist the Offshore Construction Manager (OCM) in preparing offshore project deliverables, attending project kick-off and strategy meetings, and supporting the development of offshore execution plans, construction schedules, and techno-commercial analyses. Prepare construction aids (load register), define marine spread requirements, manage pipe coating scope, and monitor fabrication/pipe coating progress. Review engineering documents, drawings, and analyses from a constructability perspective. Support the preparation of detailed scopes, schedules, and interface/bridging documents for offshore subcontracted works (excluding diving and NDT), and coordinate technical and commercial evaluations. Act as a focal point for subcontractor coordination, monitoring progress and performance. Support the issuance of Purchase Requisitions for offshore materials not covered by engineering and follow up with procurement on ordering and delivery. Coordinate offshore scope activities with all internal departments. Attend methods and constructability meetings and review installation procedures, anchor patterns, and drawings. Assist in technical evaluation, expediting, receipt, and MRV approval of offshore materials. Provide input to weekly and monthly reports and attend client meetings as required. Support studies for changes in offshore execution plans, including the preparation of bridging documents, micro-schedules, and method statements. Liaise with third-party agencies and marine warranty surveyors on marine and construction matters. Attend weekly progress meetings with VPOO/OCM and highlight issues and risks. Ensure the implementation of the project safety plan, company HSEMS, and quality standards. Capture lessons learned and best practices, and participate in quality audits and closeout actions. Initiate offshore variation orders/claims, compile technical inputs, and support the assignment of offshore durations. Assist in reviewing subcontractor invoices and provide clarifications to finance. Prepare and coordinate mobilization plans and support mobilization meetings with marine and field teams. Pre-Offshore and Execution Phase Responsibilities Prepare the Risk Assessment Register, attend RA meetings, and circulate consolidated comments to the client and internal stakeholders. Prepare job cards for offshore hook-up works and develop detailed micro-schedules and manpower histograms for shutdown activities. Prepare JUB specifications for hired marine spread in line with CHOD requirements. Coordinate with OPE to ensure the readiness and mobilization of all installation aids. Ensure timely pre-installation/load-out activities and the availability of the latest approved offshore documentation onboard. Assist in updating offshore schedules based on progress and resource availability, and propose recovery measures for delays. Support coordination of subcontractor mobilization/demobilization and performance evaluation. Monitor daily offshore operations, attend daily meetings, and coordinate closely with clients, marine, and field teams. Conduct HSE audits and safety tours on offshore spreads. Interface with project and yard construction teams to maintain load-out dates and offshore continuity. Conduct joint walk-throughs on fabricated structures to avoid offshore carry-over. Close-Out Phase Responsibilities Assist in the preparation of offshore final documentation and project close-out reports. Review contract documents and drawings to identify constructability issues and variation requirements. Support Construction Managers in directing offshore activities, ensuring resource availability, safety compliance, and adherence to contract and ISO requirements. Assist in schedule adjustments to manage changes, delays, and contingencies while controlling costs. Qualifications and Requirements 5-10 years of relevant experience. Candidates currently based in KSA or willing to relocate to KSA will be considered. Candidates with experience working on Aramco projects will be given priority. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Eastern, Saudi Arabia, focusing on projects within the Kingdom. The role requires close coordination with various internal departments, clients, and third-party agencies, ensuring adherence to project safety plans, company HSEMS, and quality standards.

d94c846764c839bc.description: About the Role Saudi Services For Electro Mechanic Works Co. SSEM is seeking a VAT Specialist to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position is critical for ensuring compliance with Saudi Arabia's VAT regulations and managing tax-related operations within the company. Role Overview The VAT Specialist will be responsible for all aspects of Value Added Tax compliance, from preparing and filing returns to managing e-invoicing requirements and supporting audits. The role requires a strong understanding of ZATCA regulations and the ability to coordinate effectively with various internal departments. Key Responsibilities Prepare and file monthly/quarterly VAT returns in full accordance with ZATCA regulations and deadlines. Ensure ongoing compliance with the Saudi Arabia VAT Law and its Executive Regulations across all transactions. Manage E-Invoicing (Fatoora) compliance, including Phase 2 integration requirements with ZATCA. Review and validate VAT treatment on supplier and customer invoices (standard-rated, zero-rated, and exempt categories). Reconcile input and output VAT accounts monthly and promptly resolve discrepancies. Support external audits and ZATCA VAT inspections by preparing documentation and responding to queries. Monitor updates to KSA tax legislation and assess the impact of regulatory changes on business operations. Coordinate with Finance, Procurement, and Commercial teams on VAT clauses in contracts and Withholding Tax (WHT) requirements where applicable. Qualifications and Requirements Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field. Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in VAT / Indirect Tax, preferably within the Saudi market. Strong working knowledge of ZATCA regulations and E-Invoicing (Fatoora) requirements. Professional certification (Recognized Diploma in Taxation) is preferred. Work Location This position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Application Process Candidates who meet the specified requirements are encouraged to apply for this full-time role.

d97a09fecbc0e415.description: نبذة عن الدور تعلن شركة وجد الحياة للتجارة عن حاجتها لمدير إداري للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى الإشراف العام على الأنشطة الإدارية، وضمان توافقها مع الخطط التشغيلية المعتمدة، وتوفير الموارد اللازمة لسير العمليات اليومية بكفاءة وفعالية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية المشاركة في صياغة الأهداف الرئيسية للشؤون الإدارية، وتطوير وتنفيذ الخطط والبرامج والمشروعات التي تساهم في تحقيقها، مع التأكد من وجود مقاييس دقيقة لتقييم مستوى الإنجاز. الإشراف على عمليات تطوير ومراجعة جداول الصلاحيات الإدارية والإجراءات المتبعة، بهدف تحسينها وضمان تقديم الخدمات الإدارية بالجودة والسرعة المطلوبة. متابعة وتوجيه أنشطة تلبية احتياجات الوحدات التنظيمية والموظفين من الخدمات الإدارية المتنوعة، مثل النقل والضيافة والنظافة، وتنظيم المراسلات والأرشفة، والتشغيل الإداري للمباني والمرافق. الإشراف على تطبيق الأنظمة والتعليمات والقرارات الإدارية، وضمان إبلاغ الوحدات التنظيمية والموظفين بكافة القرارات الصادرة عن الإدارة العليا ومتابعة تنفيذها. الإشراف على إعداد الملخصات والتقارير التي توضح نسب الإنجاز العامة في الشؤون الإدارية، وعرضها على الإدارة العليا، وإحاطتهم بالتحديات والمستجدات، واستشارتهم في القضايا والمبادرات المستقبلية. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال الإدارة أو ما يعادلها. القدرة على تطوير وتنفيذ الخطط والبرامج الإدارية. مهارات إشرافية وتنظيمية قوية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات ممتازة في التخطيط والتنظيم الإداري. القدرة على متابعة العمليات الإدارية وضمان كفاءتها. مهارات تواصل فعالة لضمان التنسيق مع الوحدات المختلفة. القدرة على إعداد التقارير والملخصات الإدارية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مكة المكرمة. سيعمل المدير الإداري ضمن فريق يسعى لتحقيق الأهداف التشغيلية للشركة بكفاءة عالية. التقديم للمهتمين بالتقديم على هذا الدور، يرجى إرسال السيرة الذاتية. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لتحديد الخطوات التالية.

d98c460777722e3e.company_name: شركة الحاج عبدالله على رضا وشركاه
d98c460777722e3e.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث الشركة العربية للتموين والمقاولات المعمارية عن كاتب سجل للانضمام إلى فريقها في الجبيل، المنطقة الشرقية. يهدف هذا الدور إلى ضمان التسجيل الدقيق والمنظم للوثائق، والمحافظة على سريتها، وإدارة السجلات بفعالية وفقاً للإجراءات المعتمدة. هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تسجيل الوثائق بعد توثيقها من الجهات المختصة، وتنظيمها وترتيبها بما يتوافق مع السياسات والإجراءات المعمول بها. مراجعة دقة البيانات في الوثائق، والتأكد من اكتمال التوقيعات والأختام، واتخاذ الإجراءات اللازمة للتعامل مع الأمور الطارئة المتعلقة بالوثائق أو السجلات. تطبيق التعليمات الخاصة بسرية المعاملات والسجلات، والتعامل معها بمهنية عالية. حفظ السجلات والوثائق وتصنيفها وترتيبها بناءً على الممارسات المعتمدة. استقبال استفسارات العملاء ومتابعة معاملاتهم وتقديم الردود على أسئلتهم. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تسجيل الوثائق وتنظيمها وترتيبها بدقة. فهم جيد لإجراءات حفظ السجلات والوثائق. المهارات المطلوبة الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في مراجعة البيانات والوثائق. الالتزام بالسرية التامة في التعامل مع المعاملات والسجلات. مهارات تنظيمية عالية لترتيب وتبويب الوثائق. مهارات تواصل جيدة للتعامل مع استفسارات العملاء. بيئة العمل يعمل كاتب السجل في بيئة مكتبية ضمن فريق الشركة العربية للتموين والمقاولات المعمارية في الجبيل. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات الداخلية لضمان سير العمل بكفاءة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة للتقديم على هذا الدور. سيتم تحديد الراتب بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة.

d9ac57b88f0f818c.company_name: KAUST (King Abdullah University of Science and Technology)
d9ac57b88f0f818c.description: About the Role KAUST (King Abdullah University of Science and Technology) is seeking a Senior Communications & Engagement Specialist for a full-time position in Thuwal, Makkah. This role is responsible for sharing the research, education, and impact of the PSE Division with local, regional, and international audiences. The specialist will translate complex technical topics into clear, engaging stories, combining a strong STEM background with proven experience in science communications and outreach activities. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement a multi-channel communications strategy aligned with PSE and KAUST objectives. Maintain a consistent brand voice and visual identity across all divisional platforms and materials. Raise the Division’s profile locally, regionally, and internationally through targeted outreach. Align divisional messaging with KAUST Missions, national priorities, and Vision 2030 goals. Promote faculty and student hiring activities, developing targeted communication campaigns to attract talent. Coordinate with the Global Branding and Communications (GBC) office, peer Divisions, research platforms, and the Education and Advancement (E&A) office. Science Communication and Storytelling Write original content in English for local and international audiences and coordinate Arabic content for in-Kingdom and regional outreach. Translate technical research in Energy, AI, Health, Sustainability, and advanced technologies into accessible stories. Work with faculty, researchers, and students to identify ongoing research stories and news. Build and lead communication activities highlighting student and alumni achievements, academic milestones, and career impact. Adapt scientific messaging to fit the cultural and institutional context of stakeholders in Saudi Arabia and the Middle East. Devise tailored content, including bilingual materials, to showcase and support in-Kingdom partnerships. Oversee internal and external publications, including newsletters, brochures, and annual impact reports. Data Visualization and Digital Engagement Collect and analyze divisional data to support strategic reporting and outreach. Create clear charts, infographics, and visual summaries for datasets covering awards, publications, and research highlights. Utilize research databases such as Scopus and Web of Science to track publication metrics. Integrate statistical data and visual analytics into leadership presentations and public communications. Manage the Division’s LinkedIn and X (Twitter) accounts, including planning and publishing. Create and maintain an editorial calendar with clear timelines and content targets. Produce posts in varied formats, including short videos, visuals, research features, and event highlights. Engage with online audiences and track social media metrics to improve content reach. Act as the Division's primary point of contact for media inquiries, in coordination with GBC. Leadership and Stakeholder Support Prepare presentation slide decks, briefing notes, talking points, and speeches for leadership. Provide practical communications advice to leadership for internal initiatives and external stakeholder visits. Develop promotional and informational materials for conferences, workshops, lectures, exhibitions, and VIP visits. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in science communications and outreach. A strong STEM background is required to effectively translate complex technical topics. The role demands proficiency in crafting accessible science stories, managing digital platforms, and preparing leadership presentations.

d93d49a396edfd3c.description: About Queen's Taste Queen's Taste is a company focused on the confectionery industry, specializing in high-quality cakes, chocolates, sweets, and baked goods. The company also provides services in hospitality, events, and catering, utilizing global technologies to ensure quality and customer satisfaction. The successful candidate will be responsible for the design, preparation, and presentation of fresh flower bouquets, floral gifts, and decorative arrangements for various customer needs, events, and special occasions. Developing customized floral designs for birthdays, anniversaries, weddings, celebrations, and other special occasions, adhering to customer requirements, budgets, and delivery schedules. Selecting appropriate fresh flowers, greenery, ribbons, wrapping materials, and color combinations to produce attractive and well-balanced arrangements. d960e4440f118a49.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة التميمي للخدمات والصيانة العالمية عن طاهي للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تحضير وطهي مجموعة متنوعة من الأطعمة، مع ضمان الالتزام بمعايير الجودة والسلامة الغذائية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الطهي. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية استلام المواد الأولية وتجهيزها وتحضيرها وطهي اللحوم والدجاج والخضراوات والأطعمة الأخرى لإعداد الأطباق المدرجة في قائمة الطعام. تحضير الشوربات وإعداد السلطات والمقبلات الباردة والساخنة. سلق وطهي الأطعمة الشرقية المختلفة. تجهيز الأكلات بعد نضوجها ووضعها في الأواني المناسبة وتحضيرها للتقديم. الإشراف على تنظيف أدوات الطبخ والطعام، والمحافظة على إجراءات وتعليمات السلامة والصحة العامة. إعداد قائمة بأصناف الطعام بناءً على الموسم والمكونات المتاحة. طلب المكونات والتوابل اللازمة حسب الحاجة لضمان توفرها. مساعدة الطهاة الآخرين أثناء عملية تجهيز الطعام لضمان سير العمل بكفاءة. وزن وقياس وخلط المقادير بدقة وفقاً للوصفات المعتمدة. الالتزام بالقوائم والوصفات المعمول بها لضمان جودة وتوحيد الأطباق. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الطهي. القدرة على استلام المواد الأولية وتجهيزها وطهيها بكفاءة. الإلمام بتشغيل مختلف أجهزة المطبخ مثل الفرن والشواية. القدرة على تحضير مجموعة متنوعة من الأطباق بما في ذلك اللحوم والدجاج والأسماك والخضراوات. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات ممتازة في تحضير وتتبيل وطهي الأطعمة. القدرة على إعداد الشوربات والسلطات والمقبلات. معرفة جيدة بإجراءات السلامة والصحة العامة في المطبخ. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق والمساعدة في مهام المطبخ المختلفة. بيئة العمل يعمل الطاهي ضمن بيئة مطبخ احترافية في شركة التميمي للخدمات والصيانة العالمية بمدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب الالتزام بمعايير العمل والجودة المحددة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة للانضمام إلى فريقنا.

d909732d37cc4d59.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة المدينه المنوره لنقل الحجاج عن سائق شاحنة صغيرة للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى ضمان نقل الحجاج والمعتمرين والزوار بأمان وفعالية، مع الالتزام التام بالمسارات والجداول الزمنية المعتمدة والتعليمات التشغيلية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال القيادة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية قيادة الشاحنة الصغيرة لنقل الركاب بأمان وفقاً للمسارات والجداول المحددة. الالتزام بأنظمة المرور والسرعات المحددة، والقيادة بسلاسة لتجنب التوقف أو التجاوز المفاجئ. الامتناع التام عن استخدام الهاتف الجوال أثناء القيادة لضمان التركيز والسلامة. إجراء الفحص اليومي للشاحنة قبل الانطلاق، بما في ذلك الفرامل والإطارات والأنوار ومستوى الوقود. التأكد من جاهزية أجهزة السلامة مثل مطفأة الحريق وحقيبة الإسعافات الأولية. الإبلاغ الفوري عن أي أعطال ميكانيكية لمركز الصيانة. التقيد بجدول الرحلة ومواعيد التوقف والوصول بدقة. استقبال الركاب بأسلوب مهذب وتقديم المساعدة اللازمة لهم، خاصة كبار السن وذوي الإعاقة. التأكد من مطابقة تذاكر الركاب أو تصاريح الصعود للفئات المصرح لها فقط. الحفاظ على نظافة الشاحنة وتشغيل التكييف والإضاءة المناسبة لراحة الركاب. تفقد الشاحنة بعد كل رحلة للتأكد من خلوها من الركاب والتعامل مع أي مفقودات. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات كسائق. رخصة قيادة سارية المفعول تتناسب مع نوع الشاحنة المطلوبة. معرفة جيدة بأنظمة المرور والسلامة على الطرق. القدرة على التعامل مع الركاب بمهنية واحترام. الالتزام بالمواعيد والجدول الزمني للرحلات. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مكة المكرمة. تتطلب الوظيفة الالتزام بالجداول الزمنية المحددة لضمان نقل الحجاج والمعتمرين والزوار بكفاءة وأمان. التقديم الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. للمهتمين، يرجى التقديم لهذه الفرصة في مكة المكرمة.

d918da4fe57753e1.description: يبحث تطبيق رش رومز للبيع والتأجير والحجوزات عن محترفين في تطوير الأعمال، يمتلكون القدرة على استقطاب الشركات والمؤجرين والبائعين، وبناء علاقات تجارية تحقق عمليات فعلية ونموًا مستمرًا. المسؤوليات الرئيسية استقطاب جهات جديدة للانضمام إلى التطبيق وعرض منتجاتها وخدماتها. التواصل مع أصحاب القرار، وفهم احتياجاتهم، وشرح حلول التطبيق وإتمام اتفاقات الانضمام. تشجيع الجهات المستقطبة على توجيه عملائها إلى روابط رش رومز لإتمام الشراء والتأجير والحجز. متابعة تفعيل الجهات وزيادة عملياتها، والتنسيق مع الفريق الداخلي لتجهيز الحسابات وإضافة المنتجات والخدمات. توثيق المتابعات والنتائج بدقة، والمحافظة على سرية البيانات. المؤهلات والمتطلبات خبرة مثبتة في تطوير الأعمال أو المبيعات، مدعومة بإنجازات قابلة للتحقق. مهارات قوية في التواصل والتفاوض والإقناع. قدرة على الوصول إلى أصحاب القرار وبناء علاقات تجارية مستمرة. مهنية عالية، ودقة في التفاصيل، وانضباط في المتابعة وسرعة في التنفيذ. استقلالية وتحمل للمسؤولية، مع التركيز على تحقيق نتائج فعلية. الفرصة ومعايير الاختيار فرصة مجزية لأصحاب الأداء المتميز، تتيح بناء عوائد متنامية ترتبط بالنتائج المحققة. العدد محدود، وسيكون الاختيار من خلال اختبارات عملية تقيس المهنية والدقة ومهارات التواصل والإقناع والتنفيذ. ولن يُختار إلا من يثبت كفاءته ويلتزم بمستوى عالٍ من الجودة والمسؤولية.

d9450cb08f592b19.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة زهران للصيانه والتشغيل عن مشرف صيانة للانضمام إلى فريقها في محايل، عسير. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى الإشراف على جميع عمليات الصيانة وضمان كفاءة الأداء التشغيلي. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الصيانة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية متابعة إجراءات تحديد نوع وطبيعة الصيانة المطلوبة، وتقدير كمية وتكلفة المواد اللازمة لإتمامها. توزيع المهام والواجبات بشكل فعال على أعضاء فريق الصيانة بناءً على إمكاناتهم وقدراتهم الفردية. متابعة وتقييم أداء فريق الصيانة بشكل دوري، وتقييم إنجازاتهم لضمان تحقيق الأهداف المحددة. تقييم الاحتياجات التدريبية لفرق الصيانة وتنمية مهاراتهم، أو التوصية بإلحاقهم ببرامج تدريبية متخصصة لرفع كفاءتهم. إعداد برامج الصيانة الوقائية ومتابعة إجراءات تنفيذها لضمان استمرارية عمل المعدات والأنظمة. تصنيف وترتيب وتوثيق وحفظ جميع النتائج وتقارير العمل المتعلقة بأنشطة الصيانة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الصيانة أو دور إشرافي ذي صلة. القدرة على قيادة وتوجيه فرق العمل بفعالية. مهارات ممتازة في التخطيط والتنظيم والمتابعة. بيئة العمل يعمل مشرف الصيانة بدوام كامل في محايل، عسير، ضمن بيئة عمل ديناميكية تتطلب التفاعل المستمر مع فرق الصيانة والإدارة لضمان سير العمليات بكفاءة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف. التقديم ندعو المهتمين والذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

d95631a228fbfe6b.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة المسك الخليجيه للصناعة عن كاتب موارد بشرية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور إلى دعم عمليات الموارد البشرية اليومية من خلال إدارة سجلات الموظفين ومعالجة الطلبات المختلفة، مما يضمن سير العمل بكفاءة ودقة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية حفظ وتحديث سجلات الموظفين، وتسجيل البيانات الشخصية للموظفين الجدد، والتأكد من اكتمال جميع الوثائق المقدمة. معالجة ومتابعة طلبات التوظيف والترقية والنقل والإعارة، وجمع البيانات الإضافية اللازمة عند الحاجة. تسجيل الوقوعات المتعلقة بحالة الموظف، وتحديث بياناته المسجلة، وحفظ المستندات المؤيدة لهذه الوقوعات، وإخطار الجهات المعنية. الحفاظ على سرية بيانات الموظفين والتعامل معها بحرص، والتحقق من عدم تسريبها أو تداولها إلا مع الأطراف المعنية وفقاً للتعليمات المحددة. إعداد التقارير المتعلقة بالتوظيف ورفعها إلى المختصين في قسم الموارد البشرية. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الموارد البشرية أو دور إداري ذي صلة. القدرة على التعامل مع البيانات الحساسة والحفاظ على سريتها. مهارات تنظيمية وإدارية جيدة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض. سيعمل كاتب الموارد البشرية ضمن فريق ديناميكي لدعم العمليات الإدارية في الشركة. المهارات المطلوبة الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في إدخال البيانات وحفظ السجلات. مهارات تواصل فعالة كتابياً وشفوياً. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق والتعاون مع الزملاء. الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات الداخلية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

d96c41776dffb7ba.description: Join the Gathern team as a Host Relations Specialist and be an integral part of ensuring a positive and memorable experience for our Host. As a Host Relations Specialist, you will play a key role in building strong relationships with our hosts and providing them with exceptional support and assistance. In this role, you will be responsible for onboarding new hosts, answering their inquiries, and providing them with guidance and resources to optimize their hosting experience. You will also act as a mediator in resolving any issues or conflicts between hosts and guests, ensuring a smooth and enjoyable stay for all parties involved. We are looking for individuals who are highly organized, customer-oriented, and have excellent communication skills. If you are passionate about hospitality and enjoy building relationships, we want to hear from you. Responsibilities Build and maintain strong relationships with our hosts, being their main point of contact. Onboard new hosts and provide support in setting up their listings and managing their profiles. Respond to host inquiries and provide guidance and resources. Act as a mediator in resolving conflicts or issues between hosts and guests. Coordinate with other teams to ensure smooth and efficient operations. Keep up-to-date with industry trends and best practices in host relations. Bachelor's/Diploma degree. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Highly organized and detail-oriented. Ability to multitask and work in a fast-paced environment. Flexible schedule, including availability on weekends and holidays. Positive and friendly attitude.

d995a9af076d6b35.description: About the Opportunity Link Datacenter is seeking a Certified Internal Quality Compliance Specialist to join our team in Riyadh. This full-time role involves ensuring the integrity and continuous improvement of our Quality Management System through diligent internal auditing practices. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Role Overview The Certified Internal Quality Compliance Specialist will be responsible for conducting comprehensive internal quality audits. This includes developing audit plans, preparing detailed reports, and identifying non-conformities to support the overall quality framework within the organization. Key Responsibilities Conduct internal quality audits in accordance with established standards. Prepare internal audit plans and comprehensive reports detailing findings. Identify and accurately document non-conformities within the quality management system. Follow up on corrective actions to ensure timely and effective resolution of identified issues. Support the continuous improvement initiatives of the Quality Management System. Required Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or an equivalent field. Possession of a relevant certified internal auditing qualification. Minimum of 3 years of experience in internal auditing of quality management systems. Demonstrated experience in preparing and conducting internal audits. Proven experience in reviewing and reporting non-conformities. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, offering an opportunity to contribute to the quality assurance framework of Link Datacenter. Application Process We invite qualified candidates to apply for this role to contribute to our commitment to quality and compliance.

d918e024aa38f092.description: About the Role Sawaco is seeking a Procurement Manager to oversee all procurement activities in Jeddah. This full-time role is essential for ensuring the timely and cost-effective acquisition of goods and services required for operations, maintaining a reliable supply chain, managing supplier relationships, and ensuring compliance with procurement policies and applicable regulations. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement procurement strategies aligned with Sawaco’s operational and financial objectives. Identify opportunities for cost savings and improvements within procurement processes. Evaluate and select suppliers based on quality, cost, reliability, and delivery performance. Negotiate supplier contracts, commercial terms, payment terms, and credit agreements. Manage the procurement of consumable materials, fittings, equipment, spare parts, and other operational requirements. Oversee the complete procurement cycle from purchase requisition through purchase order, delivery, and closure. Ensure timely and accurate processing of purchase orders and contracts. Monitor procurement budgets and control costs while maintaining quality and delivery standards. Manage supplier performance and resolve supply, quality, and delivery issues. Ensure compliance with procurement policies, regulations, and ethical standards. Identify and mitigate supply-chain and supplier-related risks. Lead, mentor, and evaluate the procurement team, supporting their professional development. Coordinate with internal departments to understand and prioritize procurement requirements. Maintain accurate records of procurement activities, contracts, and supplier performance. Prepare cost analyses and procurement reports for senior management. International Procurement and Compliance Manage international shipments and coordinate with freight forwarders and customs brokers. Ensure compliance with Saudi customs procedures, HS Codes, and applicable SASO requirements. Utilize the SABER platform for product registration and issuing conformity certificates for international shipments. Handle relevant procedures through the FASAH platform. Support customs-duty exemption applications when required. Experience and Qualifications Candidates should possess 5-10 years of experience in procurement management, demonstrating a strong understanding of supply chain operations and regulatory compliance. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Jeddah, where the Procurement Manager will lead a dedicated team and collaborate with various internal departments to achieve operational objectives.

d9393659e2d757ee.description: About the Role Tree is seeking an HR Operations Senior Specialist to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time position requires 2-5 years of experience and focuses on managing daily HR operations and ensuring compliance with labor laws. Role Overview The HR Operations Senior Specialist will be responsible for overseeing the complete employee lifecycle, from onboarding to offboarding, and managing all related HR administrative tasks. This role is critical for maintaining efficient HR processes and ensuring adherence to Saudi Labor Law and internal policies. Key Responsibilities Manage day-to-day HR operations and employee lifecycle activities, including onboarding, transfers, and offboarding processes. Handle monthly payroll processing, employee benefits administration, and related HR transactions. Manage HR government platforms, including GOSI, Qiwa, Mudad, and Muqeem. Maintain accurate employee records, HR systems, and comprehensive documentation. Ensure full compliance with Saudi Labor Law and internal HR policies. Address employee inquiries and provide support on various HR-related matters. Prepare HR reports and actively support process improvement initiatives. Qualifications and Requirements 2-5 years of experience in HR operations. Strong knowledge of Saudi Labor Law and government HR platforms. Hands-on experience in payroll processing and HR systems. Required Skills Strong communication skills. Excellent organizational abilities. Proven problem-solving skills. Location This position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

d958ce2073fbe29b.description: About the Role Al-Qahtani Pipe Coating Industries (AQPCI) is seeking an experienced Mechanical Engineer to join their team in Dammam. This full-time role involves ensuring the smooth and efficient operation of mechanical elements within the workplace. The engineer will be responsible for evaluating machine conditions and components to assess efficiency and propose improvements for enhanced performance across all product stages. Key Responsibilities Perform full lifecycle product development, including design, development, prototype testing, manufacturing, and implementation. Create detailed drawings and specifications. Conduct site visits and inspections. Perform calculations and analysis. Troubleshoot and resolve issues or discrepancies. Design systems and components that meet specified needs and requirements. Produce outline designs. Identify, formulate, and produce effective solutions to emerging problems. Source vendors and finalize technical details in accordance with business needs. Initiate and manage moderate project Bills of Materials (BOMs). Achieve working relationships with multidisciplinary teams, including electrical engineers, production, and quality personnel. Prepare product reports and documentation. Provide timely practical support to site engineering teams for resolving issues and clarifications. Test and evaluate theoretical designs. Evaluate the final product’s overall performance, reliability, and safety. Alter and modify designs to meet requirements and eliminate malfunctions. Solicit observations from operators. Engage in continuous learning and develop new methods. Required Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of experience in a relevant mechanical engineering role. Practical experience with CAD software. Knowledge of engineering and construction principles. Solid understanding of core mechanical engineering concepts, including mechanics, kinematics, thermodynamics, and materials science. Skills and Attributes Effective communication skills and the ability to lead projects. Ability to work collaboratively with individuals from diverse backgrounds. Creativity and analytical skills. Ability to communicate technical knowledge clearly and understandably. Technical writing skills. Application Process Candidates who meet the above requirements are encouraged to apply for this full-time position.

d9613e001c44fced.description: About Lean Technologies Lean Technologies is a rapidly expanding fintech company focused on building financial data infrastructure for the MENA region. Operating in a highly regulated and security-sensitive environment, the company provides critical financial services that require robust SLAs, stringent security controls, and scalable systems. Lean has processed billions in transactions and serves over 350 financial institutions and fintech clients, including Tabby, Careem, and DAMAC. The company is backed by investors such as General Catalyst, Sequoia Capital, and Bain Capital Ventures. The Role of Internal Auditor As an Internal Auditor at Lean Technologies in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, you will be responsible for independently assessing the adequacy and effectiveness of the company's governance, risk management, and internal control frameworks across all group entities. This full-time role involves executing the annual audit plan, evaluating compliance with applicable regulatory frameworks, and providing assurance to management and the Board/Audit Committee on the organization's control environment. The position requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Plan and execute risk-based internal audits across group entities, covering regulatory compliance, AML/CFT, technology and operations, governance, and financial controls. Develop and maintain the annual group audit plan and universe, ensuring appropriate coverage of high-risk areas across all licensed entities. Assess the design and operating effectiveness of controls; identify control gaps, root causes, and process weaknesses. Draft clear, actionable audit findings and reports for management and relevant committees (GLRCC, Audit Committee). Track and follow up on the remediation of audit findings and management action plans. Liaise with external auditors, regulators, and second-line functions (Compliance, Risk) to ensure coordinated assurance coverage and avoid duplication. Support internal audit outsourcing/co-sourcing arrangements where applicable, ensuring compliance with relevant regulatory restrictions on intra-group or outsourced audit work. Stay current on regulatory developments across CBUAE, SAMA, ADGM FSRA, and VARA frameworks affecting audit scope and methodology. Lead ad-hoc assessments as required by regulators and/or internal policies. Contribute to and support investigations as needed. Maintain audit working papers and documentation to a standard suitable for regulatory inspection. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of experience in internal audit or a related field. Demonstrated understanding of governance, risk management, and internal control frameworks. Familiarity with regulatory frameworks including CBUAE, SAMA, ADGM FSRA, and VARA. Ability to assess control effectiveness and identify process weaknesses. Strong report writing and communication skills. Working at Lean Technologies Lean Technologies is building financial infrastructure for the MENA region, operating as a regulated Open Banking and Open Finance company across the UAE and Saudi Arabia. The company is expanding into new markets and launching new products. Lean offers competitive salaries, private healthcare, and flexible office hours. Every team member holds a meaningful equity stake in the business to ensure long-term alignment.

d9b99a3833f29bd1.description: About Galderma Galderma is a dermatology company operating in approximately 90 countries. The company provides a science-based portfolio of brands and services across Injectable Aesthetics, Dermatological Skincare, and Therapeutic Dermatology. Established in 1981, Galderma focuses on skin health, working with healthcare professionals to meet consumer and patient needs. The Role Galderma is seeking a Medical Representative Dermatological Skincare (Hospital Line) to join its team in Makkah, covering Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time role requires 2-5 years of experience and involves executing field visits, building relationships with healthcare professionals, and promoting Galderma's dermatological skincare portfolio within the hospital line. The successful candidate will contribute to business growth and ensure product visibility and compliance. Key Responsibilities Execute planned field visits to pharmacies, pharmacists, and designated healthcare professionals according to territory coverage plans and segmentation targets. Build and maintain long-term relationships with pharmacists, pharmacy chains, and key retail stakeholders to drive product recommendation, business growth, and customer loyalty. Strengthen engagement and loyalty toward Galderma brands through consistent scientific promotion, professional customer service, and effective relationship management. Ensure excellent visibility and positioning of Galderma products across assigned pharmacy accounts, maintaining the company image as a leader in dermatology and skincare. Monitor product availability and stock levels across all target pharmacies and key accounts to ensure optimum inventory levels and avoid stock shortages or supply disruptions. Implement company commercial and marketing plans, including in-store activations, promotional campaigns, merchandising activities, and pharmacy education initiatives. Conduct product detailing, presentations, and educational sessions for pharmacists and pharmacy staff to effectively communicate product benefits, marketing messages, and campaign objectives. Organize and support pharmacy-focused meetings, activation programs, and promotional events in alignment with business objectives. Educate pharmacists on Galderma’s Integrated Dermatology Strategy (IDS) by promoting complete skincare and treatment solutions that improve consumer outcomes and maximize cross-selling opportunities across the portfolio. Optimize utilization of company resources, including time, samples, and promotional investments, in alignment with territory priorities and manager direction. Monitor territory sales performance and market trends, while developing and implementing action plans to achieve assigned targets. Prepare and submit accurate business reports, including daily activities, weekly plans, monthly updates, and territory performance analyses. Monitor competitor activities, pricing strategies, new launches, and market dynamics to identify opportunities and potential business risks. Handle pharmacy and customer complaints professionally by investigating issues, proposing solutions, and escalating where necessary. Collect and report pharmacovigilance cases in full compliance with company policies and regulatory requirements. Ensure full compliance with company legal, ethical, and compliance standards, as well as local laws and regulations, in all interactions and activities. Maintain up-to-date product, market, and category knowledge to ensure high-quality customer engagement and effective communication of scientific and commercial messages. Candidate Profile Solid sales experience with a track record of developing and engaging customers, and delivering on company targets. Analytical, detailed, passionate, organized, and systematic approach to work. Experience in territory and distributor management is an advantage. Working at Galderma Galderma aims to empower employees and promote personal growth while meeting business needs. The company values diversity and respects the dignity, privacy, and personal rights of every employee. This role offers opportunities for new work experiences and direct impact within the dermatology sector.

d9c1d3fd1d8f477f.description: نبحث عن مندوب مبيعات متحمس للانضمام إلى فريقنا الديناميكي للمساهمة في تحقيق أهداف المبيعات وتوسيع قاعدة العملاء. ستشمل مسؤولياتك عرض المنتجات، التفاوض على العقود، وبناء علاقات قوية مع العملاء لضمان رضاهم وولائهم. إذا كنت تمتلك مهارات تواصل ممتازة، قدرة على تحقيق الأهداف، وشغف بالمبيعات، فنحن ندعوك للتقديم.

d956b8166f17c6d5.description: About the Role Amgen is seeking a District Promotion Manager to join our team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves translating brand strategies into regional plans and managing sales performance within the assigned territory. The manager will lead a sales team, ensuring the effective execution of commercial tactics and the achievement of territory goals. Key Responsibilities Translate Amgen affiliate and brand strategies into regional plans to deliver successful treatments. Analyze sales performance of relevant brands in the territory and identify key levers for action, including healthcare developments like VBHC and HIC policies. Keep the business unit team informed of market changes and competitor activity relevant to strategy implementation and development. Ensure the execution of marketing and commercial tactics by developing territory plans (Plans of Action) with team members. Manage approved budgets to ensure appropriate allocation of resources to meet the plan and maintain financial control. Plan, allocate, and monitor team expenses budget to ensure budgetary control. Track the progress of marketing messages and programs. Monitor the implementation of Plans of Action throughout sales cycles and ensure budget spend within agreed time, costs, compliance, and quality parameters. Monitor, evaluate, and act on field force metrics and standards to maximize sales force effectiveness from both quantitative and qualitative perspectives. Build a high-performing sales team by recruiting and selecting candidates and effectively onboarding new hires. Coach and motivate team members to achieve or exceed territory goals and optimize individual and team engagement. Conduct annual and ongoing performance reviews and capability assessments within the framework of Amgen’s performance management process. Develop individual team members to continuously improve their overall level of performance in their role and for future talent development. Support team members on external key customer visits as needed. Take leadership in customer engagement strategies and personal external stakeholder management. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, requiring active engagement with a sales team and external stakeholders. The role involves strategic planning, performance analysis, and team development within a dynamic market. Application Process Candidates interested in this District Promotion Manager role at Amgen are encouraged to apply. Further details regarding the application process will be provided upon inquiry.

d95739c1194b8472.description: About the Role Qiddiya is seeking a Senior Manager Development COBU D D (SPA) to lead the development of retail, public realm, and special-use components across two precincts in Riyadh. This full-time role involves overseeing the planning, development, and delivery of commercial office assets within the Commercial Office Business Unit. d9f8a8ad7df15dd4.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث شركة القائمة المميزة عن موظف صندوق محاسبة للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية إدارة المعاملات النقدية والائتمانية، وضمان دقة التسجيلات المالية، وتقديم خدمة عملاء ممتازة. هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية عد وتسجيل المبالغ المالية في آلة تسجيل النقود في بداية وردية العمل، والتأكد من توفر كمية كافية من العملات الصغيرة. استلام المدفوعات نقداً أو عن طريق بطاقة الائتمان أو أي طرق دفع معتمدة أخرى، ودفع المبالغ المتبقية وتحرير الإيصالات اللازمة. تحديث قوائم الأسعار بشكل مستمر، وحساب أسعار السلع أو الخدمات، وإعداد جداول الفواتير، وتطبيق الخصومات عند اللزوم. تسوية النقدية الواردة مع إجمالي المبيعات في نهاية الوردية، والإبلاغ عن أي اختلافات أو تسويتها. التعامل مع العملاء بترحيب وتلبية طلباتهم المتعلقة بإضافة أو حذف عناصر من قوائم الشراء. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على التعامل مع المعاملات النقدية والائتمانية بدقة. مهارات جيدة في خدمة العملاء والتواصل الفعال. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في المدينة المنورة، وستكون جزءاً من فريق عمل ملتزم بتقديم أفضل الخدمات للعملاء. تقديم الطلبات لمزيد من المعلومات حول هذه الفرصة الوظيفية أو لتقديم طلب، يرجى التواصل مع شركة القائمة المميزة. الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

Competitive salary and benefits package. Exciting projects and innovative work environment.

d98b6123aed0d56d.description: Eram Talent is seeking a highly qualified Senior Horticulturist to join our team. In this pivotal role, you will be responsible for leading horticultural practices and providing expertise in the cultivation of various plant species. Your knowledge and skills will contribute to the design and implementation of effective growing strategies, enhancing both production quality and sustainability. As a Senior Horticulturist, you will work closely with other professionals to ensure that all horticultural activities align with our commitment to excellence and innovation. Job Description: Bachelor’s degree in Agriculture or equivalent from a recognized and approved program. 10 years of experience in gardening, landscaping, agriculture, or equivalent, including at least 8 years in horticulture, gardening, plantations, or equivalent. Responsibility for directing research and experiments to identify land use problems, suitable plant varieties, techniques for nursery operations, and best methods for planting, spraying, cultivating, harvesting, storing, processing, or transporting agricultural/horticultural products, as well as pest/weed management. Provision of guidance on planning and developing community projects, including the development of programs to achieve quality landscaping designs, effective implementation, and potential cost reduction. Provision of guidance on training programs for staff personnel in the latest agricultural/horticultural technologies or methodologies, including plant insect/pest control. Study and analysis of soil characteristics, along with the development of improved measurement techniques, soil conservation methods, soil sampling devices, or other relevant technologies. Design of work programs for implementation by Gardening, Landscaping, and Nursery personnel. Includes review and advisory responsibilities regarding staff performance, along with the preparation of periodic reports for supervisory evaluation. Coordination and implementation of Integrated Pest Management (IPM) programs to control horticultural and agricultural pests in all landscaped areas, including residences. Advisory and instructional responsibilities on plant pest control, including the conduct of surveys, sample collection, and study of plant pests and materials to enhance pest control efforts.
